svg.title: API3 — POST /invoices/{id}/approve happy path
svg.desc: Request flow for invoice approval with GL entry generation
svg.text: Happy path: approval + GL entry generation
409 VERSION_CONFLICT — If-Match doesn't match current version (concurrent modification)
422 SOX_VIOLATION — creator_id == approver_id (same person cannot approve own invoice)
423 PERIOD_CLOSED — invoice_date falls in a CLOSED or LOCKED period
422 INVALID_STATUS — invoice not in DRAFT state (already approved, void, etc.)
